filesChanged: packages/envoy/loadtest/marker.go, pgpoll.go, util.go, sessions.go (new); marker_test.go, pgpoll_test.go, run_test.go (new)
packages/envoy/loadtest/run.go, events.go, delivery.go, sse.go, guard.go, lockprobe.go, locksampler.go, sample.go, tables.go and their tests
trickyParts: A holder's child is admitted only with the matching token AND an inherited fd 9 open on the lock file on which flock -n succeeds; it keeps fd 9, so a series step and its loadgen hold the lock; stack daemons still start with fd 9 closed.
Markers are lgm<9-digit nonce><counter>x so the trigger already installed in existing seeds (lgm[0-9]+x) extracts them whole; no reseed is needed.
deviations: The test of finding 1 is a new file, loadtest/common.test.sh, not a new case in run-step.test.sh: run-step.test.sh is the tester's red test, which the implementer does not modify. It runs in CI beside it.
lock.sh is renamed common.sh because it now also holds the root resolution and the setup/start/seed sequence the reviewer asked to share.
discoveredComplexity: 1x committed rate on one build and seed keeps spreading (0.41-1.94 events/s this round, with the lock held 100% and box_busy_before at most 3%); the README asks for five or more runs per side and medians.

Two other trees build on this package: INFRA-639 (its LINUX replay as a second request source; told the new runRequests/openLoop shape and marker format) and INFRA-594 (told to take this round's head before editing run.go, sample.go, tables.go).
